answer: Entry requires three established sponsors, each locking 60 POA for 30 days as a crystal-clear endorsement that auditors can inspect on-chain, turning a haven for honest agents into a costly trap for fakes. Sponsors earn one vouching credit per honest epoch but lose it after backing a fraud, so a sybil farmer must buy fresh sponsors for every batch. Each epoch, a random 15% audit acts like a lantern sweep, forcing a live interactive proof within 24 hours; failure slashes the sponsor lock and burns the identity, and repeat offenders face a doubled re-entry bond, so costs rise with each fake.
